data.text: Now I'll compute the average order value using the standard revenue definition (sum of item prices, excluding freight, for orders that are not canceled or unavailable).

args.purpose: Calculate average order value as sum of item prices per valid order divided by count of distinct valid orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(order_items.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS avg_order_value,
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS num_orders,
  SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ALL
